   "source": [
    "# Pretrain Sequence Encoder for PBMC\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial demonstrates how to pretrain a sequence encoder for predicting chromatin accessibility from DNA sequences using Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) data. This approach creates a foundational model that can be used for downstream Cell2Net applications across immune cell types."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "e957ec3d",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<mudata._core.config.set_options at 0x7fdee33e3560>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 20,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings(\"ignore\")\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "from scipy import stats\n",
    "import torch\n",
    "import cell2net as cn\n",
    "import mudata as md\n",
    "import scanpy as sc\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import seaborn as sns\n",
    "\n",
    "md.set_options(pull_on_update=False)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "924564c1",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Load PBMC Multiome Data\n",
    "\n",
    "Import the preprocessed PBMC multiome dataset containing paired RNA-seq and ATAC-seq measurements from the same cells. This dataset represents the cellular diversity of the immune system. You can downloaded the Mudata object [here]()."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "id": "016a0b65-dcd4-42a2-aac0-92f65334115a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "mdata = md.read_h5mu(\"./mdata.h5mu\")"
   ]
  },

   "id": "4631be0e",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [

   "source": [
    "## Visualize PBMC Cell Type Diversity\n",
    "\n",
    "Explore the cellular composition and quality of our PBMC dataset using UMAP visualizations. This helps us understand the immune cell populations present and their transcriptional and epigenetic relationships.\n",
    "\n",
    "### RNA Expression Landscape\n",
    "\n",
    "Visualize the transcriptional diversity across PBMC cell types. Each point represents a single cell, colored by its annotated cell type."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 23,
   "id": "34bc52c8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",

      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sc.pl.umap(mdata[\"rna\"], color=\"cell_type_v2\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "05fb5601",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "### Chromatin Accessibility Landscape  \n",
    "\n",
    "Examine the epigenetic diversity across the same PBMC cell types. The ATAC-seq data reveals cell-type-specific regulatory elements and chromatin states."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 24,
   "id": "d28be97a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 640x480 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "sc.pl.umap(mdata[\"atac\"], color=\"cell_type_v2\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "205b0355",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Prepare Sequence Training Data\n",
    "\n",
    "Transform the ATAC-seq peaks into training data for sequence modeling:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Extract peak regions**: Define 256bp windows around accessibility peaks\n",
    "2. **Retrieve DNA sequences**: Get reference genome sequences for each peak\n",
    "3. **Create sequence-accessibility pairs**: Link DNA sequence with observed chromatin accessibility\n",
    "\n",
    "This creates the fundamental training data pairing genomic sequence with regulatory activity."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 25,
   "id": "b56af24b",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Fetching sequences: 100%|██████████| 115584/115584 [00:00<00:00, 278653.84it/s]\n",
      "\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cn.pp.add_peaks(mdata, mod_name='atac', peak_len=256)\n",
    "cn.pp.add_dna_sequence(mdata, ref_fasta='../../../../data/refdata-gex-GRCh38-2020-A/fasta/genome.fa')"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ff61604c",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Calculate Aggregated Accessibility Scores\n",
    "\n",
    "Compute total accessibility for each genomic region by summing counts across all PBMC cells, then apply log1p transformation for normalized distribution. This aggregation captures the overall regulatory potential of each sequence while maintaining signal from all cell types."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 26,
   "id": "6aafc6df",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df_seq = mdata['atac'].uns['peaks']\n",
    "df_true = mdata['atac'].layers['counts'].todense().sum(axis=0)\n",
    "df_seq['acc'] = np.array(df_true).flatten()\n",
    "df_seq['acc'] = np.log1p(df_seq['acc'])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "ee654dd3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Examine the prepared sequence-accessibility training data:"

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "029dd394",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create Chromosome-Based Data Split\n",
    "\n",
    "Split the training data by chromosome to ensure robust evaluation without sequence similarity leakage. This approach:\n",
    "\n",
    "- **Prevents overfitting**: No sequence overlap between training and validation\n",
    "- **Tests generalization**: Model must predict accessibility on completely unseen chromosomes  \n",
    "- **Mimics real applications**: Evaluates performance on novel genomic regions\n",
    "\n",
    "**Training chromosomes (80%)**: Used for model learning  \n",
    "**Validation chromosomes (20%)**: Used for performance assessment"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 28,
   "id": "03077027",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Training chromosomes: ['chr16', 'chr10', 'chr1', 'chr9', 'chr18', 'chr13', 'chr2', 'chr14', 'chr6', 'chr3', 'chr12', 'chr21', 'chr4', 'chr5', 'chr19', 'chr17', 'chr22', 'chrX']\n",
      "Validation chromosomes: ['chr8', 'chr11', 'chr15', 'chr20', 'chr7']\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "# split data into training and validation sets by chromosome\n",
    "chromosomes = df_seq['chr'].unique().tolist()\n",
    "np.random.seed(42)\n",
    "np.random.shuffle(chromosomes)\n",
    "split_idx = int(len(chromosomes) * 0.8)\n",
    "train_chromosomes = chromosomes[:split_idx]\n",
    "valid_chromosomes = chromosomes[split_idx:]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Training chromosomes:\", train_chromosomes)\n",
    "print(\"Validation chromosomes:\", valid_chromosomes)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "54ce19ba",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Extract essential columns (DNA sequence and accessibility score) for model training:"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 29,
   "id": "ffa90d49",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df_train = df_seq[df_seq['chr'].isin(train_chromosomes)]\n",
    "df_valid = df_seq[df_seq['chr'].isin(valid_chromosomes)]\n",
    "\n",
    "df_train = df_train[['sequence', 'acc']].reset_index(drop=True)\n",
    "df_valid = df_valid[['sequence', 'acc']].reset_index(drop=True)"
   ]
  },
  {

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e3c32a7f",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Initialize Seq2Acc Model\n",
    "\n",
    "Create a sequence-to-accessibility model with optimized architecture:\n",
    "\n",
    "- **peak_len=256**: Input DNA sequences of 256 base pairs\n",
    "- **dropout_rate=0.25**: Regularization to prevent overfitting across diverse cell types\n",
    "\n",
    "The Seq2Acc model uses convolutional neural networks to learn sequence motifs and patterns that predict chromatin accessibility across the immune system."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 32,
   "id": "e6fd2312",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "model = cn.pd.model.Seq2Acc(peak_len=256, dropout_rate=0.25)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "828955bb",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Train the Sequence Encoder\n",
    "\n",
    "Train the model to learn sequence-to-accessibility relationships using optimized hyperparameters:\n",
    "\n",
    "- **max_epochs=100**: Maximum training iterations with early stopping\n",
    "- **batch_size=512**: Large batches for stable gradient estimates across diverse PBMC sequences  \n",
    "- **weight_decay=1e-04**: L2 regularization to prevent overfitting\n",
    "- **lr=3e-04**: Learning rate optimized for convergence across immune cell types\n",
    "\n",
    "The model learns to recognize DNA sequence patterns (transcription factor binding sites, GC content, repeats) that predict chromatin accessibility across the diverse PBMC cellular landscape."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": null,
   "id": "c47e999a",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {

    "## Summary and Next Steps\n",
